status: confirmed discrepancies; pixel equivalence not established
references: Four checked-in native OpenCiv2 runtime screenshots, identified in repository README.md. They are not newly captured original-executable screenshots.
freshOriginalCapture: Not obtained: computer-use app approval timed out when launching an isolated copy of the installed executable. No live screenshot or runtime-parity claim is made.
comparison: Unpaired states/viewports. No whole-image pixel-difference score or pass/fail parity threshold.

rows.title: Diplomacy audience
rows.provenance: Repository README identifies this as a native OpenCiv2 runtime screenshot. Different leader, era, government, technology list and power rank from the mockup.
findings: Text face, color, size, baseline and wrapping differ. The screenshot has small dark multi-line knowledge labels; the mockup has pale, single-line truncated labels.
ASTERIAN ENVOY, COMMUNISM and the MILITARY/KNOWLEDGE captions are extra adapter text, not text emitted by the extracted audience routines.
The runtime screenshot includes the animated herald. The mockup exercises only the static audience. Different artwork selections reflect supplied state, not proof of a crop or palette bug.
rows.focus: Knowledge labels: different technologies/eras, so inspect typography and wrapping rather than subtracting pixels.

rows.title: City management window
rows.provenance: Runtime screenshot is the full desktop/window at 1024x768. The mockup is a 636x421 content fixture at view_scale=2. Population, yields, improvements and units differ.
findings: Fonts and shadows differ, and the original text colors are replaced by one pale color. Text metrics and label strings are simplified.
The runtime economy panel has the original food, trade/distribution and shield rows. The mockup substitutes six separate role rows. This is a layout difference, not merely a font mismatch.
The mockup changes button arrangement and omits the title bar, scrollbars and several original controls. Its resource terrain and present-unit details are supplied adapters.
Native citizen/yield/stockpile draw selection is retained for the supplied state; those tests do not validate the entire city window.
rows.focus: Economy panel: source-scale screenshots are deliberately not rescaled to suggest identical geometry.

rows.title: City panorama
rows.provenance: Runtime screenshot is London, June 1940, in a 1024x479 viewport. The mockup is a synthetic 1280x480 coastal composition with a different building set.
findings: The runtime draws the city name and year at the top. The mockup omits CityViewWindow::draw_title entirely.
Viewport/camera, building inventory and city size differ. Matching artwork and native slot routines alone do not establish equal placement for these different inputs.
rows.focus: Title band: present in the game screenshot; no title draw occurs in the mockup.

rows.title: Map view
rows.provenance: Runtime screenshot is the June 1940 scenario with full UI. The mockup uses the real 1788 save, a different viewport/zoom, and deliberately disables fog.
findings: City names, window chrome, minimap and status panels are present in the runtime screenshot and omitted by this map fixture.
Badge/size text uses approximate widths and SVG monospace glyphs. The source font selection, glyph masks and exact text metrics are not executed.
Terrain, coastline and network selection tests remain useful, but this is not a matching-save/matching-camera pixel comparison.

fonts.limits: Metrics from the port’s Wine-reference bitmap bank, not a fresh Windows GDI measurement. Map-shim values illustrate its fixed-width approximation; they are not the diplomacy SVG renderer’s measured output.

sourceEvidence.fact: Knowledge labels select face 0, size 11, and era-dependent colors.
font_handle_create maps face 0 to Times New Roman, negative pixel height, regular/bold style.
The port uses reference glyphs/metrics and separate 1-bit and antialiased text paths.
CIV2_WINE_TEXT selects measured advances; normal port layout uses drawing advances.
Window text requests a generic SVG font stack and uses a simplified baseline.
OriginalPainter substitutes one global light text color and dark shadow.
Knowledge names are sliced to eight characters, not fitted using source metrics.
science_draw_tech is a stub: selection and rectangles survive, shaping does not.
text_set_colors is a no-op in the window harness.
Zoom font selection is a no-op; width is strlen times an estimated character width.
Map text uses SVG monospace glyphs and a heuristic baseline.
Map city-name drawing is a no-op.
Resource terrain, buttons and present-unit details are adapter methods.
The city resource map uses a supplied repeating terrain pattern.
CityViewWindow::draw_title draws city name/year with two palette-colored passes.
City panorama harness calls layout/draw_buildings and emits a 1280x480 scene without draw_title.
Diplomacy heading, government and column captions are added by the mockup.
Spacecraft title, statistics and buttons are supplied by the adapter.
